title: Insured Plan of Care Coinsurance Base: Visits Over the Unit Maximum and Uncovered Telehealth
content:
**Billing desk reference — Insured Plan of Care.** When a coinsurance charge is reviewed against the visit it belongs to, the amount a coinsurance percentage is applied to follows how the reviewed visit was billed:

1. For a **telehealth treatment visit on a payer program that does not cover telehealth**, it is zero.
2. For **any other visit billed with more timed units than the payer program's per-visit maximum**, it is the allowed amount prorated to that maximum, that is the allowed amount times the maximum units divided by the units billed, rounded half up to the cent.
3. For **every other visit**, it is the visit's allowed amount.

## Payer program terms this rule reads

| Payer program | Telehealth covered | Timed units per visit, maximum |
|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Plan of Care | Yes | 4 |
| Commercial High-Deductible Plan of Care | Yes | 4 |
| Commercial POS Plan of Care | Yes | 4 |
| Commercial HMO Plan of Care | Yes | 4 |
| Medicare Part B Plan of Care | No | 6 |
| Medicare Advantage Plan of Care | Yes | 4 |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan of Care | Yes | 4 |

## Both sides of the unit maximum (hypothetical visits)

| Payer program | Visit kind | Units billed | Allowed amount | Amount the coinsurance percentage is applied to |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO (maximum 4) | Treatment | 4 | $150.00 | $150.00 — at the maximum, not more than it |
| Commercial PPO (maximum 4) | Treatment | 5 | $150.00 | $120.00 — $150.00 times 4 divided by 5 |
| Commercial HMO (maximum 4) | Treatment | 6 | $100.00 | $66.67 — 66.666… rounded half up |
| Medicare Part B (maximum 6) | Treatment | 7 | $161.00 | $138.00 — $161.00 times 6 divided by 7 |
| Medicare Part B (telehealth not covered) | Telehealth treatment | 2 | $70.00 | $0.00 |
| Medicare Advantage (telehealth covered) | Telehealth treatment | 2 | $70.00 | $70.00 |

The telehealth line applies only where the payer program does not cover telehealth; on every other program a telehealth treatment visit is treated like any other visit, prorated if its units exceed the maximum and taken at its allowed amount otherwise.
